blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No low-pressure area (LPA) or tropical cyclone was expected to form inside or outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) in the next three days, the state weather bureau said on Monday. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), the shear line and easterlies are the weather systems currently affecting the country. “Based on our data and analysis, no LPA or tropical cyclone will form in the next three days,” Pagasa weather specialist Aldczar Aurelio said in a morning forecast.
